summary: Prevent OMP tool-result stalls by serializing message admission rather than the lifetime of an idle-started run

replay.detail: Pending admission is not acknowledged on replay. Admitted messages retain delivered/read recovery and rejected admissions remain retryable.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Both shipped OMP channel assets recognize the matching user message_start as admission of an idle send. Streaming delivery still awaits queue admission; FIFO batching and native ask/approval holds are unchanged. No watchdog changes.

downtime.detail: No daemon or seat restart is performed by this change.

manual.detail: Publish the new content-addressed hook set and refresh eligible seats through the normal activation workflow. Existing sessions keep their current hook until refreshed.

recovery.detail: No persistent state migration or new rollback restrictions. Delivery receipts describe admission, not run success.
